name: What is the process for hiring Maine Results, Inc. for finish carpentry?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for hiring Maine Results, Inc. for finish carpentry?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation where we discuss your vision, inspect the project area, and take necessary measurements. Following this, we provide a detailed proposal outlining the scope of work, materials, and estimated costs. Once approved, we schedule the work, ensuring coordination with other trades if it's part of a larger project. We communicate throughout the installation to ensure the results meet your expectations. Preparation for this process includes having a clear idea of the styles you prefer and any existing architectural details you want to match or complement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hiring us involves an initial consultation, a detailed proposal, scheduling, and consistent communication throughout the installation process.
